note: One leg, exactly as it was shipped to a live Aqua, and the terms it must decode to. Three decoders read this file's bytes: contracts/src/SurfaceLens.sol (Solidity), subgraph/src/decode.ts (AssemblyScript, in the mapping) and web/src/components/surface/decode.ts (TypeScript, the browser fallback). A one-byte disagreement between them would put a wrong strike on a screen with no error anywhere, so they are pinned to one vector rather than to three copies of it.
description: A 2,600 USDC strike, 60% implied vol, 7-day covered call on WETH, notional 12 WETH, wrapped in Coverage.
